summary: The new sum-zero argument shows the degree-one comparison needs no divisibility hypothesis at all, yet the PR keeps `hqD` on the existing degree-one theorem and `hv` on the all-degree theorem and bolts on two case-split theorems instead of generalizing them. The now-unnecessary `hS`/`hv` hypotheses downstream should go with them.
